cells.title: Source
body: A 2023 npj Digital Medicine article examined ChatGPT-generated scientific references.
The paper documented fabricated references as a concrete scholarly-output failure mode.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The model produced references that appeared plausible but did not correspond to real publications.
The case records bibliographic hallucination before it becomes a legal or clinical filing.

cells.output: The source described fabricated references as outputs that can look formally credible while failing source verification.
